desc:
How to Play:
🏃 Run, triple jump, dash and wall run across the city
🥚 Grab eggs and carry them home to your farm
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Pets earn coins every second, even while you run
⬆️ Train on your treadmill to gain +1 Speed
🚀 Faster = farther jumps = luckier eggs!
🐲 Escape the dragons or they'll steal your egg!
🔁 Rebirth to multiply your coins and unlock capes & trails

✨ 115 pets, 16 rarities and Golden, Emerald, Ruby, Diamond & Rainbow eggs (up to x25!)
🌙 Egg Night every 7 minutes: new eggs everywhere!
🍀 Lucky Egg events make eggs even luckier
🏆 Reach #1 in the Hall of Fame and get your own statue!

🎁 Like & favorite the game to claim a FREE gift!
📱 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
